newsitem.title: USA: D.H. Marketing says Q3 net about $0.24/shr.
newsitem.headline: D.H. Marketing says Q3 net about $0.24/shr.

text.p: D.H. Marketing & Consulting Inc said on Wednesday that its third quarter earnings were about $0.24 a share on sales of $550,000.
The company has about 1,150,000 shares outstanding
The company said its preliminary figures were turned over to its accountants for further review.
D.H. Marketing was a development stage firm a year ago, D.H. Marketing president David Hagen said in a telephone interview.
Hagen said he is "confident" about the company making $0.40 a share in the fourth quarter.
